what: While the photo frame is sticky on screen, the next photo pushes up from 120% below the frame and covers the previous one, which gets pushed up 10% and scales 1.05 → 1. Each photo has a section height of 150lvh, progress = Scroll × (sections − .5). After 3/4 has passed, the big number 01 → 02 rolls 1em (1.2s, second digit .05s later)

options.per: Scroll length of one photo (lvh), default 150
options.rise: Distance (%) below where the next photo starts, default 120
options.push: Distance the covered photo is pushed up (%), default 10
options.zoom: Amount the covered photo shrinks, default .05 (1.05 → 1)
options.turn: Point where the number moves on to the next (ratio within one section), default .75
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Cell where photos overlap (required) — the [data-fx-part inside=item] one card at a time
options.[data-fx-part=count]: Vertical number strip (if present) — child is one line each of 01, 02… If each spot has its own strip there are several, delayed .05s from the second on

note: The part sets the section height as photo count × per and attaches the cell with position: sticky — it doesn’t break in inner scroll panels either. Cell size and side text are up to the consuming side.

from.where: index.html .ar-stack (five photos per product · number 01/05) — original scrollSticky component
